title: Stabilize header save badge + compact Vault publishing UI with hover tooltips

requirements.summary: Stabilize save-status badge sizing so it never causes header or mobile menu layout shift while remaining to the right of the project name.
acceptanceCriteria: Toggling saveStatus between idle/saving/saved does not change the header’s overall width, spacing, or cause nav items to move on desktop.
Toggling saveStatus does not cause the mobile menu’s project header row (project name/blockchain/save status) to shift.
The save status remains visually located to the right of the project name (not moved to a different header area).

file_operations.description: Render a non-jittering save-status slot by always reserving consistent inline space (e.g., fixed/min width and height) and toggling visibility/opacity instead of mounting/unmounting when status is idle; keep text aligned and readable for saving/saved.

Ensure both desktop header project row and mobile menu project header row treat the SaveStatusIndicator as a fixed-size element to the right of the project name (e.g., consistent flex behavior and no reflow when status changes).

requirements.summary: Replace always-visible Vault publishing instruction text with hover tooltips on Lock/Unlock/Upload buttons without changing publishing behaviors.
acceptanceCriteria: The Vault page no longer shows the three-line help text block describing Lock/Unlock/Upload below the publishing controls.

Hovering each button shows a tooltip with exactly these meanings:
- Lock: “Prevents regeneration and enables upload.”
- Unlock: “Allows regeneration but clears upload status.”
- Upload: “Uploads images and metadata to IPFS via Pinata.”
The tooltips work for all button states (enabled/disabled) without breaking existing click behaviors.

file_operations.description: Create a small, self-contained hover/focus tooltip wrapper component (outside frontend/src/components/ui) that can show explanatory text when hovering/focusing a wrapped control, including when the wrapped button is disabled.

Remove the always-visible help text block and wrap the Lock, Unlock, and Upload buttons with the new HoverTooltip so each shows the exact required tooltip copy; ensure wrapper hover works even when the button is disabled and does not alter existing click/disable logic.

requirements.summary: Make the Vault publishing status alert more compact while keeping the status meaning and CID readable across all states.
acceptanceCriteria: The status alert uses reduced padding/typography so it occupies noticeably less height than the current implementation.
In the uploaded state, the alert still clearly communicates “Uploaded successfully!” and displays the Metadata CID (as currently shown).
Other alert states (no generation, missing Pinata key, uploading progress, upload failed, locked-ready) remain understandable and functional in the compact layout.

file_operations.description: Adjust the status alert layout to be denser (reduced padding, smaller typography, tighter gap) while keeping icon + message clear; ensure the uploaded message still displays “Uploaded successfully!” and the Metadata CID in a readable, wrap-friendly way; preserve clarity for all other publishing states.
